---
name: Report a reproducible defect
about: Code, provenance, calculation or publication errors
title: "Defect: "
---

## Artifact and version

Link the affected release, file, experiment or checksum.

## Reproduction

Give a minimal command or numerical example, environment, expected result and actual result. Do not include secrets or private EEG.

## Impact

Which inputs, outputs or conclusions are affected? If uncertain, say so. Published corrections retain the original version and explain the change.
